name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
label: Quest
description: Ragnar Thunderbrew: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ho, friend. I heard that Ragnar Thunderbrew is steaming mad about someone stealing his ale. He's looking for stalwart adventurers, and willing to pay plenty.
Talk to Ragnar if you're interested. He's at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, in Dun Morogh.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You're right I'm mad! I've been robbed! Robbed of one of our family recipes! How dare they! As if I didn't have enough cause to hate the Dark Iron dwarves! Now, oh... Now they're in for it!
